evidence: Looks up the DiamondDynasty property map, verifies its PICKEDPITCHER value against the supplied 32-bit selector, and returns true only on equality; caller repeats the predicate with alternative property strings. decompiled/main/main_0080.c:6766-6796,6845-6861.

The PITCHER/BATTER strings are tested inside a larger routine that selects and dispatches callbacks, but the body and available caller index do not establish a concise overall semantic purpose. decompiled/main/main_0109.c:9047-9182 (role string branches at 9161-9174).

Reads a signed requested position, resolves DD_LINEUP_DATA then its position list, checks the indexed entry and updates the context's position state only when the entry validates. decompiled/main/main_0079.c:6044-6087.

Parses an input text buffer for the :DELAY= marker and :UNSKIPPABLE tag, extracting and storing tag-derived values; direct caller invokes it while preparing text state. decompiled/main/main_0166.c:893-943, caller at decompiled/main/main_0166.c:785-789.

The body resolves Scorebar_SlideUps and processes nested ModifiableText records using attribute evaluators, but the exact output/purpose is insufficiently established for a reliable semantic label. decompiled/main/main_0111.c:8227-8305.

Constructs a PORTALROOM action record and in the corresponding branch appends the EnterGame token while assembling associated action data; the body uses the token as output text, not merely as a nearby string. decompiled/main/main_0120.c:50943-50995; alternate branch at 50999-51036.

Resolves GAME_LIST_DATA.total_pages, adjusts the context page index at +0x98 up or down according to the direction argument, and signals boundary conditions. decompiled/main/main_0085.c:47835-47861,47868-47895.
Selects CROWD_DIS_02 or CROWD_POS_03 based on dispatch state, copies the selected key, and applies it through the context update helper at x19+0x50dc. decompiled/main/main_0119.c:45149-45181.
